visuals.caption: A circle with centre M through the corners of an equilateral triangle ABC, with radii MB and MC drawn.
Circle M with an inscribed angle of 70° at C and the central angle (3Z + 20)° on the same arc AB.
Circle M with an inscribed angle of 115° at C and the central angle (3L + 10)° on the same arc AB.
Circle M with an inscribed angle of 45° at C and triangle MAB with angle x° at A.
Circle M with angles of 25° at B and 32° at A, and the angle y° at M between radii MB and MA.
Circle M with diameter BD, chords CA and CB, radius MA, an 85° angle at M and the angle (Z − 15)° at C.
Circle M with CA parallel to BM, a 55° angle at A and the angle L° at C.
Circle M with the central angle (x + 135)° on arc AB and the inscribed angle x° at C.
Circle with centre M and triangle ABC inside it; CB and BA have one tick each, angle B is 50°, and angles at C and A are marked y° and Z°.
Rectangle ABCD inscribed in a circle with centre M; diagonal CA passes through M, MB is drawn, angle A is 40° and angles at C and D are marked x° and y°.
Circle with diameter BA through centre M and point C on the circle; angle A is 40°, and angles at B and C are marked x° and y°.
Inscribed angle ACB and the central angle AMB stand on the same arc AB of circle M.
Circle with centre M, tangent from A touching it at B, line through D, M, C and A, chord DB and dashed radius MB; angle A is 40°.
Circle with centre M and triangle DBA inscribed; MC is perpendicular to chord AB at C, MA is drawn and MB is dashed.
Circle with centre M; inscribed angle ACB and central angle AMB stand on the same arc AB.
Circle with diameter AB through centre M and point C on the circle; triangle ABC has its angle at C standing on the semicircle.
Triangle ABC inscribed in circle M with arcs AB, BC and AC marked 4x°, 5x° and 3x°.
Circle with points A, B, C; arc BC is 110°, arc CA is 92°, and angle B between BA and BC is (x + 1)°.
Triangle ABC inscribed in a circle; arc BC is 140° and angle C is 60°.
Circle with diameter BA through centre M and point C on the circle; arc BC is 128°.
Circle with chords CB and CA; the three arcs CB, CA and BA each have one tick, so they are equal.
Circle with E, D, C, B on it; lines EA and CA meet outside at A, chord EB is drawn, EB and BA each have two ticks, and arc EC is 104°.
Circle M with radii MA and MB making the central angle AMB.
Quadrilateral DABC inscribed in a circle with diagonal DB; angle ADB is 30° and arc DA is 90°.
Chords DC and BA cross at E inside the circle; DA is dashed and the angle at E is marked.
Lines AE and CE meet outside the circle at E, cutting it at B and D; BC is dashed and the angle at E is marked.
Two rays from A cut the circle at D, E and B, C, and chords CD and BE cross at X, with 26° at C and 40° at A.
Two rays from A cut the circle at D, E and B, C; angle A is 36°, arc EC is 104°, and arcs DE and BC are marked equal.
Circle M with diameter AD, chords AC and AB, radii MC and MB, and angles of 30° and 40° at A.
Case 1: the centre M lies on one side of the inscribed angle, chord CB being a diameter, with CA and radius MA drawn.
Case 2: the centre M lies inside the inscribed angle ACB, with a dashed line from C through M and radii MB and MA.
Case 3: the centre M lies outside the inscribed angle ACB, with a dashed line through C and M and radii MA and MB.
Circle M with a central angle of 110° on arc AB and an inscribed angle x° at C on the same arc.
Circle M with an inscribed angle of 40° at C and the central angle (y + 10)° on the same arc AB.
